title: DTLS c509 handshake over 3-hop TSCH (server=root node1, client=node4)

test.description: Line topology, 50 m spacing (tx_range 55 -> 3 hops). node1 = c5t server + RPL root + TSCH coordinator; nodes 2..3 = relays; node4 = c5t client (resolves root via EDHOC_CONF_SERVER_FROM_ROOT). Read the client's 'EDHOC finished' timestamp for handshake latency vs hop count. (M1 metric = handshake latency: validate on 'EDHOC finished'; the post-handshake OSCORE GET is best-effort UDP and unreliable over multi-hop.)
